jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Joybuy is JD.com’s dedicated retail platform for Europe, offering products across a wide range of categories. Operating across the UK, Netherlands, Germany, France, Belgium and Luxembourg, we’re building the future of retail through smart systems, bold ideas, and a customer-first mindset. Backed by JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, and its trusted global technology and supply chain ecosystem, we deliver a shopping experience that is speedy, reliable, and genuinely enjoyable. If you’re ready to make a difference, bring your talent and grow with us. Don’t just buy, Joybuy.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://about.joybuy.com/about/

**About The Team**

You’ll be joining the Joybuy team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**About the Role**

To win in Europe, Joybuy needs to feel local: present in the moments, communities and conversations that matter to our customers. As Integrated Marketing Manager, you will make that happen.

This is a hands-on role spanning external partnerships, events, communications, onsite campaigns and product-led marketing. You will bring creative ideas to life and connect them with the right products, promotions and business results, building Joybuy’s local relevance and commercial impact across Europe.

**What You'll Do**

* Build partnerships with brands, media, sports events, communities and lifestyle platforms.
* Plan and deliver integrated campaigns across online and offline channels.
* Lead event marketing, co-marketing, topical campaigns and local activations.
* Drive key commercial moments such as Black Friday, Christmas, Spring Sale and 618 Summer Black Friday.
* Develop onsite promotions, product launches, category campaigns and weekly or monthly commercial moments.
* Work closely with Country, Category, Brand, Paid Media, PR, CRM and Operations teams.
* Identify the right products, hero SKUs and customer opportunities for each campaign.
* Track campaign performance, including traffic, new users, conversion, campaign GMV and product sales uplift.
* Turn successful campaigns into repeatable playbooks.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5–10 years of experience in integrated marketing, partnerships, brand marketing or e-commerce.
* Ideally, experience on both the brand or e-commerce side and the agency side.
* Strong creative thinking and campaign planning skills.
* Experience in partnerships, events, communications or local market activation.
* A good understanding of products, promotions, customer journeys and e-commerce operations.
* Strong commercial sense and the ability to connect marketing activity with GMV.
* Excellent resource integration and project management skills.
* Hands-on, flexible and comfortable in a fast-changing environment.
* Local market knowledge and an existing partnership or agency network.
* Experience with TikTok, social platforms, sports, lifestyle or community marketing.

**What Success Looks Like**

You will help Joybuy build stronger local connections, create high-impact campaigns and turn partnerships and marketing activities into measurable customer and business growth.

**What We Offer**

Joining Joybuy means becoming part of a business where people, innovation, and impact work together to shape the future of cross-border e-commerce. You’ll contribute to smart supply chains, efficient logistics, and meaningful projects that drive real customer value. With a competitive salary, great office locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to grow your career, learn from talented colleagues, and make a genuine impact in a fast-expanding international business.

**Description**
Oritain is a global leader in forensic origin verification of products and raw materials. With offices in London, Auckland, Dunedin, Paris, Singapore and Washington D.C, our vision is to be the source of truth in global supply chains.
  
  
Through our proprietary methodology, our mission is to harness cutting edge science, data, and specialised services to create a community of origin verified buyers and suppliers, protecting our people and planet. We empower the world’s leading brands to make positive changes across their supply chain; ensuring product integrity, meeting regulatory demands, and reducing the risk of fraud and unethical sourcing, creating real change in our world.
  
  
**About the role:**
As Senior Marketing Manager, you’ll set Oritain’s global marketing strategy and turn it into clear plans across EMEA and the US, working in close partnership with our APAC Marketing Manager. This is a 12-month fixed term contract covering maternity leave, based in London and reporting to our Chief Marketing Officer.

You own how Trident shows up in the market.

We are looking for a highly talented Senior Copywriter to help shape how IMG speaks to the world.

This is a senior creative role with responsibility for setting the standard of written work across the agency’s owned channels and marketing communications. You will turn strategy, insight and complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives that build IMG’s reputation, support commercial growth and connect with audiences across sport and culture.

You will lead copy development across executive thought leadership, B2B email marketing, RFPs, social media, and the website. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, the Creative team and Corporate Communications to define the brief, shape the story and deliver work that is distinctive, accurate and effective.

As a senior member of the team, you will also raise the quality of the wider creative output through constructive feedback, mentoring and a strong point of view on craft, tone and messaging.

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

* Own and evolve IMG’s written voice across owned channels, ensuring every piece of communication is clear, confident, consistent and commercially purposeful.
* Lead the development of high-quality copy from brief to final delivery, challenging the brief where needed and bringing clarity to complex or technical subject matter.
* Partner with senior stakeholders and executives to create thought leadership, including opinion pieces, articles, interviews, speeches, LinkedIn content and industry commentary.
* Shape B2B marketing content that positions IMG’s capabilities, demonstrates its expertise and supports lead generation, business development and client relationships.
* Lead copy for RFPs, credentials, sales decks, case studies, capability materials and other high-value commercial communications.
* Develop and oversee copy for IMG’s website, social channels and email marketing, adapting messages for different audiences, formats and stages of the customer journey.
* Work with Corporate Communications to develop messaging for press releases, announcements and public relations initiatives.
* Create content and narrative ideas for industry events, including panel themes, moderator notes, speaker briefs and supporting communications.
* Research sport, culture, media and marketing trends to identify relevant insights and turn them into useful, engaging stories.
* Edit, proofread and provide senior-level feedback on marketing and sales materials, maintaining a high standard of accuracy, consistency and craft.
* Act as a trusted editorial partner to designers, marketers, executives and subject-matter experts, helping teams make stronger decisions about messaging and narrative.
* Mentor junior writers and contribute to a culture of feedback, collaboration and continuous improvement across the Creative team.
* Help establish efficient ways of working for copy development, including briefs, reviews, approvals, content planning and quality control.
Use AI tools responsibly to support research, idea generation, structure and workflow, applying human judgement to every output.  

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Seven or more years of experience in copywriting, content, editorial or a related role, preferably within an agency, marketing or sports environment.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating strategic and creative writing across multiple formats, platforms and audiences.

We are working with an exciting, fast-growing premium beauty and lifestyle brand that is entering its next stage of international growth.

With an established presence in the UK and US and ambitious plans to expand into new markets, the business is looking for a talented Senior Brand Manager to help shape its global brand strategy and ensure a consistent brand identity across international markets.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who has experience working within a global brand, collaborating with international teams and setting the brand standards that guide how a business presents itself around the world.

Working closely with the senior leadership team, you will play a key role in developing global brand guidelines, supporting local market teams and managing external creative agencies to bring the brand to life across different countries and cultures.

This is a hybrid role with 2/3 days in the London HQ.

**The Role**

* Develop and implement global brand guidelines, ensuring consistency in positioning, visual identity, tone of voice and customer experience across all international markets.
* Work closely with global and local marketing teams, providing guidance, support and direction to ensure brand standards are understood and consistently delivered.
* Establish brand frameworks, creative toolkits and approval processes that allow local markets to execute campaigns whilst maintaining a consistent global identity.
* Understand the cultural differences between markets and adapt brand messaging and creative appropriately without compromising the overall brand positioning.
* Take ownership of the day-to-day relationship with external creative agencies, managing briefs, creative development, feedback, approvals and delivery.
* Lead the development and execution of integrated brand campaigns, supporting international expansion and new market launches.
* Work collaboratively with Digital, Social, PR and Commercial teams to ensure brand consistency across all customer touchpoints.
* Support international partners and franchise teams with local marketing initiatives, campaigns and brand activations.
* Use customer insights, market research and brand performance data to identify opportunities and support commercial growth.
* Help shape the brand experience across both digital and physical environments.

**About You**

We are particularly interested in speaking with candidates from premium beauty, luxury, lifestyle or retail brands who have genuine international brand management experience.

* Global brand experience: You must have worked within an established global brand, with direct involvement in managing brand positioning and consistency across multiple international markets.
* Working with global teams: Proven experience collaborating with and supporting marketing teams across different countries, ensuring everyone works towards a consistent brand identity.
* Global brand standards: Hands-on experience developing, implementing or managing global brand guidelines, frameworks and creative toolkits, ensuring consistent execution across international markets.
* Cultural adaptation: A strong understanding of how to adapt brand positioning, messaging and campaigns to different cultures and consumer behaviours whilst protecting the core brand identity.
* Creative agency management: Demonstrable experience directly managing external creative agencies, from briefing and creative direction through to feedback, approvals and final delivery.

You will also bring strong stakeholder management skills, excellent creative judgement and the confidence to influence teams across different markets.

We are looking for someone who is both strategic and hands-on, comfortable setting brand direction but equally happy getting involved in the detail to ensure exceptional execution.

**Why This Opportunity?**

This is an opportunity to join a premium consumer brand at an exciting stage of international expansion.

You will have genuine influence over how the brand is positioned globally, working closely with senior leadership and international teams to help shape its next stage of growth.

If you have experience managing a brand across multiple markets, enjoy working with creative agencies and understand the importance of building a consistent global brand identity, we would love to hear from you.

If you have not heard within 2 weeks of applying, please assume on this occasion that your application has not been shortlisted. We may retain your CV to contact you about future employment opportunities that are being managed by The Growth Foundation Talent.*
